result.summary: Found 1 issue: a layout overlap causing text collision in the restaurant listing.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing, the delivery time and delivery fee text are overlapping/colliding, making the text unreadable and visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout or spacing to ensure the delivery time and delivery fee text do not overlap. Consider placing them on separate lines or increasing the horizontal spacing between them.
